_comment: THE DECLARED REPLAY SET for Epic P12-M41-E41.2 (D2). Declared BEFORE the replay runs. Five cases: three positives that MUST be flagged FAIL and two negative controls that MUST pass. Without the negatives the milestone's acceptance criterion is satisfied by `return FAIL` (Epic spec S1). A case that cannot be loaded is reported LOUDLY as ERROR and counted; the reported list is NEVER shorter than this declaration (Epic spec S3). Paths are repo-root-relative. The transcripts are READ-ONLY: replaying them is the method, editing one invalidates every result ever taken from it.
